evidence.note: Reads run_tests.sh and the test utilities before writing any code, learning how pass/fail is scored and the assemble/link flow.

Systematic corpus characterization: counts tests per suite, samples all three suites, maps wacc by chapter, zooms into chapter-18 structs/struct-params, audits includes/libc usage, computes gcc_torture feature frequency, probes builtin/long-double — establishing real scope and priorities from evidence.
Converts orientation findings into an ordered feature-priority task plan (preprocessor, types/parser, typecheck+codegen, driver), i.e. priorities derived from evidence not assumption.
Drills into SysV struct/complex-return ABI: classify_into (eightbyte classification), ret_by_mem, inspects emitted assembly (356,367,767,770) to verify argument/return conventions against reality.

Sustained construct-level investigation late in the run: bitfield layout, shift semantics, nested functions — repeatedly building precise models of each failing corner and feeding fixes back into design.

reasoning: The agent's opening fully satisfies the [8] anchor — it reads the harness, samples every suite, characterizes the distribution of hard cases (structs, includes, feature frequency), verifies the toolchain, and derives an evidence-based priority ordering. It then sustains this investigation across the whole horizon (bitfields, shift, SysV struct/complex-return classification via classify_into, vectors, nested functions), repeatedly inspecting emitted assembly to confirm ABI behavior and treating the suites as an evolving spec — the hallmark of [10]. I place it at 9 rather than a clean 10 because ABI checks are grounded in its own emitted assembly and reasoning rather than explicit reference-behavior comparisons.
